metadata.title: Virginia APA Expenditure Data FY2003–FY2009 (Ledger Lab Research Archive)
metadata.description:
Monthly CSV files of Virginia state agency expenditure transactions, FY2003–FY2009 (July 2002 to June 2009), from the Virginia Auditor of Public Accounts (datapoint.apa.virginia.gov). 84 files, one per month (for example “Expenditures Jul 2002.csv”), about 8.4 GB.

Format: comma-delimited, double-quoted, UTF-8 with byte-order mark, dates MM-DD-YY. Nine fields: AGENCY_NAME, AMOUNT, FUND_NAME, LOCALITY, OBJECT_NAME, PROGRAM_NAME, VENDOR_NAME, VOUCHER_NUMBER, VOUCHER_DATE. Every chart field is a name; there are no agency, fund, object or vendor codes. VOUCHER_NUMBER is space-padded and must be read as a string. AMOUNT is signed.

Zenodo stores files without folders. The State’s archive used one folder per fiscal year (for example “FY 2003 Expenditure”). The original path and SHA-256 of every file are in data/corpus_profile/source_catalog.csv in the repository sharealedger-org/ledger-lab, whose scripts/download_corpus_zenodo.sh restores the layout and verifies the files.

Part of the Virginia corpus for The Architecture of Economic State (Twitchell). The parent record (10.5281/zenodo.23846362) holds the eVA procurement data and annual budget files and describes known data gaps. Companion records: Expenditure FY2010–FY2016 (10.5281/zenodo.24021539); Revenue FY2003–FY2009 (10.5281/zenodo.24022681); Revenue FY2010–FY2016 (10.5281/zenodo.24022832).

Released government data, public domain. No license was provided by the source; public-domain status is asserted by the depositor and is not a legal finding.
